facts.statement: Portellsaurus is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous of Spain.
facts.quote: Portellsaurus (meaning "Portell Lizard") is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous Margas de Mirambell Formation of Spain.

facts.statement: The single species Portellsaurus sosbaynati is known from a partial right dentary.
facts.quote: The genus contains a single species, Portellsaurus sosbaynati, known from a partial right dentary.

facts.statement: Portellsaurus was discovered in 1998 by Miquel Guardiola, Julián Yuste, and Silvia Fabregat near Mas de Curolles.
facts.quote: Portellsaurus was discovered in 1998 by Miquel Guardiola, Julián Yuste and Silvia Fabregat in a site near Mas de Curolles.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, an almost complete right dentary labeled MQ98-II-1, is housed at the Colección Museográfica de Cinctorres in Castellón.
facts.quote: Portellsaurus is known from an almost complete right dentary, MQ98-II-1, which is stored at the Colección Museográfica de Cinctorres in Castellón.

facts.statement: Portellsaurus is distinguished from other styracosternans by the lack of a bulge below the coronoid process and a deep oval cavity in the lower jaw's adductor fossa below the eleventh and twelfth teeth.
facts.quote: Portellsaurus can be distinguished from other styracosternans through the possession of two unique features: the absence of a bulge along the ventral margin directly below the base of the coronoid process, convergently found in Altirhinus and Sirindhorna, and the presence of a deep oval cavity on the middle of the lower jaw's adductor fossa below the eleventh-twelfth tooth position.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis by Santos-Cubedo et al. classified Portellsaurus as a derived non-hadrosauromorph hadrosauroid.
facts.quote: Santos-Cubedo et al. performed a phylogenetic analysis based on the dataset used in the redescription of Iguanodon galvensis and recovered Portellsaurus as a derived non-hadrosauromorph hadrosauroid.

facts.statement: Portellsaurus belongs to the parent group Hadrosauroidea.
Portellsaurus is classified within the class Ornithischia.
Portellsaurus lived during the Barremian stage, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Barremian (125.77 to 121.4 million years ago)
